note: Short pass ids, hidden 128, AdamW peak 1e-3. Full 199 MiB budget.

Long pass ids, a million away from the reserved 13-digit measurement ids. Kept weights are the best holdout state. Further fresh Adam steps at 3e-4 raised a track, and smaller rates did too, so the rest of the 199 MiB budget was not applied.

Focus fine-tune. Legal and coding weighted at 3, proofreading, syntax, errors, crash, and lint at 2.5, plus tutorial, achievement, navigation, moderation, analytics, subtitles, and photo mode. AdamW peak 3e-5. All five tracks fell. The cycle stopped after 64 rejected chunks and kept this state. The separate local transformer holdout logprob moved from -5.617680 to -5.448432 over 827 steps and was kept as a candidate, not a serving model.
